prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1131; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Presenting complaints included neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion of the cervical spine, with intermittent headaches originating at the base of the skull. No loss of consciousness was reported. Neurological examination was within normal limits, and imaging was not required based on clinical findings.

Diagnosis: Cervical strain (whiplash-type soft tissue injury) without radiculopathy.

Treatment provided over the course of care consisted of 18 visits, including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, a graded progressive cervical range-of-motion program, postural education, and home exercise instruction. Pain levels improved steadily from the initial presentation, and range of motion approached functional limits by the final visits.

At discharge, the patient reported minimal residual neck stiffness with occasional discomfort after prolonged computer use. Patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
